name: Fenugreek
summary: Fenugreek (Trigonella foenum-graecum) is a legume whose seeds supply soluble fiber, steroidal saponins, and the amino acid 4-hydroxyisoleucine. It is studied mainly for glucose control: a meta-analysis of clinical trials found that fenugreek seed intake lowered fasting glucose, post-load glucose, and HbA1c relative to control, with significant effects concentrated in people with diabetes taking medium-to-high doses. Most of the included trials were small or of modest methodological quality, so the evidence is promising rather than conclusive.
description: Saponins and fiber reduce glucose absorption and improve insulin sensitivity.
safetyNotes: GI discomfort, maple odor in sweat
